thread:
sam: Quick question — I'm planning a TF change to add an IAM permissions boundary to the IRSA role for the model-runner namespace and also add KMS re-encrypt grants on the customer key. Want a quick sanity check before I push.

maria: Do we actually need ReEncrypt? Which flow is using it? :eyes:

sam: Yes — model-runner proxies requests to a legacy transformer that performs a rewrap: decrypt with the customer key and re-encrypt to a temporary key. So the proxy needs kms:ReEncryptFrom and kms:ReEncryptTo (plus Encrypt/Decrypt/DescribeKey).

jin: Quick reminder — when creating a kms grant for an IRSA role, grantee_principal must be the role ARN (the role the service account assumes). Also watch out for permissions boundaries blocking kms actions. Can you paste the TF snippet you plan to use?

sam: Sure, here's what I had in mind:

```hcl
resource "aws_kms_grant" "modelrunner_reencrypt" {
  name              = "modelrunner-reencrypt"
  key_id            = aws_kms_key.customer_key.key_id
  grantee_principal = module.irsa.model_runner_role_arn
  operations        = ["Encrypt", "Decrypt", "ReEncryptFrom", "ReEncryptTo", "DescribeKey"]
}
```

maria: Two quick notes: 1) Grants tied to role ARNs are fine but remember IRSA roles are assumed via web identity — make sure the role's assume policy matches the serviceaccount. 2) If you add a permissions boundary that denies kms:ReEncrypt*, the grant won't help — boundaries are enforced at the role level.

sam: Thanks — boundary currently allows kms:* for keys in prod/* namespace, but I think this key name doesn't match that pattern. I'll either relax the boundary for this role or scope the key name into prod/. I'll open a PR to adjust the boundary and add the grant resource.

jin: Consider whether a key policy change might be preferable to a grant. Key policies can be more explicit (principal allowed) and survive key rotations. If you go TF grants, add lifecycle ignore_changes for "name" to avoid churn. Also add a condition like "StringEquals": {"aws:CalledVia": "our-proxy"} only if we can guarantee the header.

maria: :thumbsup: Also add a k8s annotation on the secret that references the KMS key ARN for auditability. And tag the grant with env/model-runner so infra-scan picks it up.

infra-bot: CI: terraform plan succeeded on branch sam/irsa-kms-reencrypt (seeded run).

sam: Great — thanks. I'll push the PR and tag @maria and @jin for review shortly.
